Haryana HTET Exam Date 2026 - Complete Details

Short Information :Board of School Education (BSEH), Haryana has recently released the Exam Date for the PRT, TGT, PGT Test on the official website of BSEH. Candidates Can Also Check All Details on Official SarkariResult2026, Online applying process for Haryana HTET Online Form 2026 were accepted from 24 December 2025 to 05 January 2026. The examination is going to conducted on 04 & 05 July 2026. Candidates must check the complete details for Haryana HTET Exam Date 2026 which has given below..

Important Dates

  • Notification Date : 24 December 2025
  • Application Start Date : 24 December 2025
  • Last Date : 05 January 2026
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 05 January 2026
  • Correction Form : Notify Later
  • Exam Date : 04-05 July 2026
  • Admit Card : Before Exam

Application Fee

  • For Level One
  • General, OBC, EWS : Rs. 1000/-
  • Other State (Including SC & PH) : Rs. 1000/-
  • SC, PH Candidates of Haryana : Rs. 500/-
  • For Level Two
  • General, OBC, EWS : Rs. 1800/-
  • Other State (Including SC & PH) : Rs. 1800/-
  • SC, PH Candidates of Haryana : Rs. 900/-
  • For Level Three
  • General, OBC, EWS : Rs. 2400/-
  • Other State (Including SC & PH) : Rs. 2400/-
  • SC, PH Candidates of Haryana : Rs. 1200/-
  • Pay the Examination Fee Through Debit Card, Credit Card, Net Banking, E Challan
